widgets_values: Recreate the exact camera trajectory and the single expressive physical gesture of <Video 1> as a five-second GLAMBOT slow-motion fashion portrait, starring the woman described below with her giant mecha guardian, using any enabled character-reference pictures to preserve her appearance. When reference pictures are enabled, they supply ONLY the character identity, face, hairstyle, original complete outfit, accessories, mecha design, environment and lighting. They do NOT lock the starting pose or framing. If no picture is provided, generate the character and world from the written description below. <Video 1> supplies ONLY the moving camera path, framing progression, action timing, turn direction and slow-motion cloth and hair inertia. Replace every person, outfit and background from the video with the world and characters described below, guided by the enabled reference pictures when available. The scene contains orange-haired woman holding a closed book, ornate white black and gold sun-patterned dress, towering white-and-gold knight mecha, sunlit grand library. She flicks the edge of her layered orange-and-white skirt outward with one hand and turns her shoulders into a confident pose, her closed book held low by her other hand. The camera begins close on the moving skirt and golden ornaments, then makes one continuous rising sweep up the torso to her face and settles on her gaze. The large guardian mecha stays behind her throughout, recognizable within the moving composition. Compose freely for the gesture, with room for her arms and flowing fabric. One continuous cinematic take: a decisive real physical gesture captured with a high-speed camera and played back in extreme slow motion, with clearly changing poses, airborne fabric and flowing hair. The camera is moving through three-dimensional space as in the reference, creating strong parallax. Match the smooth slow-motion cadence of the reference. Beautiful expressive eyes, confident red-carpet performance, crisp facial detail, natural anatomy, coherent armor and costume. Quiet ambient sound only. No speech, captions, names, lower-thirds, logos, red carpet, spectators, duplicate women, costume changes or cuts.

5秒 / 24fps / 9:16
第一轮0.5MP；潜空间放大1.5倍。原生输出832×1472，124帧；成片828×1472，120帧。
种子260927588，固定。动态强度0；语义桥alpha0.1。

nodes.title: 参数与构图说明

widgets_values:
橙发Claude位于阳光洒入的宏伟图书馆，背后是白金骑士机甲。
一只手向外轻甩层叠裙摆，另一只手低持合上的书，肩膀转为自信姿态。
镜头从飘动裙摆和金色饰物的近景开始，连续沿躯干上升至面部，最终停留在眼神。
一个明确动作以高速摄影慢放的感觉展开，衣料与头发保留惯性；镜头在三维空间运动，产生视差。
保持脸、服装、机甲一致；不复制参考片中的人、红毯与背景。无切镜、无重复人物、无字幕、无logo、无对白；仅安静环境声。
这些约束已写入相连的英文提示词，不需要另填负面提示词。
九图版本支持关闭全部图片：此时只按文字描述生成Claude，不再受到原图身份约束。
nodes.title: 动作、镜头和声音（中文说明）

widgets_values:
原片：慢镜头还得看格莱美.mp4
选段13:14.10–13:18.60，原长4.5秒。
参考片统一为5秒、24fps、512×288，共120帧，去除原声。
原片节选、实际参考视频和Claude角色原图均在工程中。
原版成片以及本次验证成片分开保存，固定种子不保证跨软件版本逐像素一致。

widgets_values:
九个图片入口全部保留；每个入口同时连接第一轮和第二轮。
开关面板 yes=启用，no=停用；也可选中图片节点按Ctrl+M切换（Mode: Never/Always）。
先在图片节点上传/选择图片，再启用对应开关。空白入口必须保持停用。
默认仅图片01开启。任意开启0～9个位置，不要求连续。全no时，所有图片加载节点都不进入提交给后端的生成任务；保留视频参考。
主提示词已兼容0图，不再写死<Image 1>。无图片时人物主要由文字描述决定，不能保证保留Claude原图身份。
多图请明确其用途；换角色时同步改提示词。若自行写<Image N>，N按当前实际启用图片的顺序编号，关图后需要检查标签。
API JSON是默认单图配置快照；界面开关状态需由ComfyUI重新导出API才会反映到API文件。
